title: Jumppower O Meter
features:
simple jumppower meter

shows your current jumppower in a small gui

- draggable (mobile works)
- live update
- toggle button (hides text only)

made this cuz I wanted to see jumppower while testing

client-side
script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

-- Create JumpPower Meter GUI
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0.2, 0, 0.1, 0)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 0.85, 0) -- Position it separately from speedometer
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30)
frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3
frame.Active = true
frame.Draggable = true -- Make it moveable
frame.Parent = screenGui

local jumpText = Instance.new("TextLabel")
jumpText.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.7, 0)
jumpText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
jumpText.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
jumpText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
jumpText.TextScaled = true
jumpText.Text = "JumpPower: 0"
jumpText.Parent = frame

-- Create Toggle Button
local toggleButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.3, 0)
toggleButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.7, 0)
toggleButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
toggleButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggleButton.TextScaled = true
toggleButton.Text = "Turn OFF"
toggleButton.Parent = frame

local isJumpMeterOn = true

-- Toggle JumpPower Meter Visibility
toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    isJumpMeterOn = not isJumpMeterOn
    jumpText.Visible = isJumpMeterOn
    toggleButton.Text = isJumpMeterOn and "Turn OFF" or "Turn ON"
end)

-- Update JumpPower Every Frame
local runService = game:GetService("RunService")

runService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if isJumpMeterOn and humanoid then
        jumpText.Text = "JumpPower: " .. math.floor(humanoid.JumpPower)
    end
end)
